    29	#include "net/ip6_address.hpp"
    30	#include "utils/wrap_string.h"
    31	
    32	#include "test_util.h"
    33	
    34	struct Ip6AddressStringTestVector{
    35	    const char *  mString;
    36	    const uint8_t mAddr[OT_IP6_ADDRESS_SIZE];
    37	    otError       mError;
    38	};
    39	
    40	static void checkAddressFromString(Ip6AddressStringTestVector *aTestVector)
    41	{
    42	    otError          error;
    43	    ot::Ip6::Address address;
    44	
    45	    error = address.FromString(aTestVector->mString);
    46	
    47	    VerifyOrQuit(error == aTestVector->mError, "Ip6::Address::FromString returned unexpected error code\n");
    48	
    49	    if (error == OT_ERROR_NONE)
    50	    {
    51	        VerifyOrQuit(0 == memcmp(address.mFields.m8, aTestVector->mAddr, OT_IP6_ADDRESS_SIZE),
    52	                     "Ip6::Address::FromString parsing failed\n");
    53	    }
    54	}
    55	
    56	void TestIp6AddressFromString(void)
    57	{
    58	    Ip6AddressStringTestVector testVectors[] =
    59	    {
    60	        // Valid full IPv6 address.
    61	        {
    62	            "0102:0304:0506:0708:090a:0b0c:0d0e:0f00",
    63	            {0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07, 0x08,
    64	             0x09, 0x0a, 0x0b, 0x0c, 0x0d, 0x0e, 0x0f, 0x00},
    65	            OT_ERROR_NONE
    66	        },
    67	
    68	        // Valid full IPv6 address with mixed capital and small letters.
    69	        {
    70	            "0102:0304:0506:0708:090a:0B0C:0d0E:0F00",
    71	            {0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07, 0x08,
    72	             0x09, 0x0a, 0x0b, 0x0c, 0x0d, 0x0e, 0x0f, 0x00},
    73	            OT_ERROR_NONE
    74	        },
    75	
    76	        // Short prefix and full IID.
    77	        {
    78	            "fd11::abcd:e0e0:d10e:0001",
    79	            {0xfd, 0x11, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
    80	             0xab, 0xcd, 0xe0, 0xe0, 0xd1, 0x0e, 0x00, 0x01},
    81	            OT_ERROR_NONE
    82	        },
    83	
    84	        // Valid IPv6 address with unnecessary :: symbol.
    85	        {
    86	            "fd11:1234:5678:abcd::abcd:e0e0:d10e:1000",
    87	            {0xfd, 0x11, 0x12, 0x34, 0x56, 0x78, 0xab, 0xcd,
    88	             0xab, 0xcd, 0xe0, 0xe0, 0xd1, 0x0e, 0x10, 0x00},
    89	            OT_ERROR_NONE
    90	        },
    91	
    92	        // Short multicast address.
    93	        {
    94	            "ff03::0b",
    95	            {0xff, 0x03, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
    96	             0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0b},
    97	            OT_ERROR_NONE
    98	        },
    99	
   100	        // Unspecified address.
   101	        {
   102	            "::",
   103	            {0},
   104	            OT_ERROR_NONE
   105	        },
   106	
   107	        // Valid embedded IPv4 address.
   108	        {
   109	            "64:ff9b::100.200.15.4",
   110	            {0x00, 0x64, 0xff, 0x9b, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
   111	             0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x64, 0xc8, 0x0f, 0x04},
   112	            OT_ERROR_NONE
   113	        },
   114	
   115	        // Valid embedded IPv4 address.
   116	        {
   117	            "2001:db8::abc:def1:127.0.0.1",
   118	            {0x20, 0x01, 0x0d, 0xb8, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
   119	             0x0a, 0xbc, 0xde, 0xf1, 0x7f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01},
   120	            OT_ERROR_NONE
   121	        },
   122	
   123	        // Two :: should cause a parse error.
   124	        {
   125	            "2001:db8::a::b",
   126	            {0},
   127	            OT_ERROR_PARSE
   128	        },
   129	
   130	        // The "g" and "h" are not the hex characters.
   131	        {
   132	            "2001:db8::abcd:efgh",
   133	            {0},
   134	            OT_ERROR_PARSE
   135	        },
   136	
   137	        // Too many colons.
   138	        {
   139	            "1:2:3:4:5:6:7:8:9",
   140	            {0},
   141	            OT_ERROR_PARSE
   142	        },
   143	
   144	        // Too many characters in a single part.
   145	        {
   146	            "2001:db8::abc:def12:1:2",
   147	            {0},
   148	            OT_ERROR_PARSE
   149	        },
   150	
   151	        // Invalid embedded IPv4 address.
   152	        {
   153	            "64:ff9b::123.231.0.257",
   154	            {0},
   155	            OT_ERROR_PARSE
   156	        },
   157	
   158	        // Invalid embedded IPv4 address.
   159	        {
   160	            "64:ff9b::1.22.33",
   161	            {0},
   162	            OT_ERROR_PARSE
   163	        },
   164	
   165	        // Invalid embedded IPv4 address.
   166	        {
   167	            "64:ff9b::1.22.33.44.5",
   168	            {0},
   169	            OT_ERROR_PARSE
   170	        },
   171	
   172	    };
   173	
   174	    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < OT_ARRAY_LENGTH(testVectors); index++)
   175	    {
   176	        checkAddressFromString(&testVectors[index]);
   177	    }
   178	}
   179	
   180	#ifdef ENABLE_TEST_MAIN
   181	int main(void)
   182	{
   183	    TestIp6AddressFromString();
   184	    printf("All tests passed\n");
   185	    return 0;
   186	}
   187	#endif
